classification: Additive OracleSafetyCheck v4 asset-proxy fields with v3 default issuance; no existing signed layout, activation or partner policy change
receiptImpact: No existing signed layout changes. OracleSafetyCheck v4 (31 fields: the 27 v3 fields plus sourceAssetProxyStatus, sourceAssetProxyRelation, sourceAssetUnderlyingId and sourceAssetProxyNominalRatioBps) and OracleSafetyRecheck v4 (33 fields) are ADDED to the production router and to the standalone verifier. OracleSafetyCheck v1, v2, v3 and OracleSafetyRecheck v2, v3 remain byte-identical, and historical receipts keep verifying unchanged; version routing is explicit, so v4 is only reached when schemaVersion 4 is requested. Default issuance remains v3, so no existing caller sees a different receipt. A missing proxy assessment is signed as UNKNOWN with ratio 0 instead of being treated as 1:1 or "no relation", and verification echoes assetProxy with an asset_proxy_unknown warning; a signature-valid but internally contradictory combination fails with asset_proxy_inconsistent. No registry release, attester key, partner policy, activation set or trust pin changes. WBTC is the first registered relation (bip122:000000000019d6689c085ae165831e93/slip44:0 at 10,000 bps), which is a declared nominal claim rather than a custody audit.
activationRule: Existing partner policies and activation set v6 remain unchanged and no partner is newly activated. OracleSafetyCheck v4 is opt-in per request and confers no trading, execution or data-source authority. This promotion records an additive signed-layout registration only; it does not publish a verifier release, authorize a live partner run or change production reachability. Production release remains gated on main.
